arithmeticProof.proof: Let M=65536 and c=kM+r. Then c*q and r*q have the same residue modulo M. Signed reinterpretation of either r or q changes the product by a multiple of M, so wordMultiplyLow after truncating operands is exactly the original unchecked Int16(long product). The original Int32*UInt16 product fits Int64. DC must independently preserve original full-width product+1024 then Int16 saturation.
